nodes.label: Run and operate the local beta
nodes.rationale: Source-only semantic extraction of current local-beta operations guide.
nodes.norm_label: run and operate the local beta
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Supported local runtime
nodes.rationale: The guide requires Node.js 24, 25, or 26, pnpm 11.20.0 through Corepack, and 1 GB of free disk space.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Local launch workflow
nodes.rationale: START-NIMANTO.command on macOS or corepack enable, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, and pnpm dev start the local beta; workbench and website use127.0.0.1:4300, health and OpenAPI use127.0.0.1:4310.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Private launch key
nodes.rationale: The launcher supplies the key and pnpm dev prints the private URL; bare workbench entry and return after sign-out remain disabled until the launch-secret key is supplied.

nodes.label: Loopback deployment boundary
nodes.rationale: Public binding requires production authentication, secure cookies, TLS and reviewed deployment configuration; the beta defaults to loopback.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: SQLite exclusive database ownership
nodes.rationale: Current main keeps a Node built-in SQLite exclusive lock in .nimanto-lock.sqlite; OS process exit and crash release ownership. The persistent sidecar contains no candidate records; PGlite remains the candidate database.

nodes.label: Stopped ownership protocol upgrade
nodes.rationale: Never delete, replace or restore the SQLite sidecar while any Nimanto process runs; keep it with stopped backups. Stop all processes before upgrading and never mix old/new lock protocols. The guide states Node24-26 availability and cites Node24 documentation that labels SQLite release candidate.

nodes.label: Legacy lock marker recovery
nodes.rationale: The complete .nimanto-lock JSON marker stays while open for older clients, which do not serialize stale recovery. Known dead owners recover; empty, malformed or live markers block startup. Verify all processes stopped before removing an unreadable legacy marker only; DATA_DIRECTORY_IN_USE requires stopping the owner, not deleting SQLite.

nodes.label: Versioned source upgrade
nodes.rationale: For v0.9.0, stop API, copy complete .nimanto-data, checkout exact v0.9.0 and reinstall the locked dependency graph before restart.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Schema version 15
nodes.rationale: Current main schema15 includes legacy Packet/Action hashes at6, role dispositions/notes at7, discovery/government trust at8-12, Career Ledger/status migration markers at13, append-only Submission Records at14, and manual-role idempotency, legacy role identity review, Answer topic/prompt revisions and corrected migration observation time at15. Manual-role operation ledger is excluded from exportv10.

nodes.label: Transactional migration recovery
nodes.rationale: Record migration version only after commit; resume from last completed step. Refuse newer-schema databases, replay idempotent base/tenant triggers on open, and run one-time mutations only for missing versions. No downgrade guarantee: restore stopped backup or fix forward.

nodes.label: Private email-bound invitations
nodes.rationale: Public signup is disabled. Administrator issues72-hour single-use email-bound invitation via bootstrap-secret header; acceptance requires exact email and creates an empty tenant-isolated workspace. URL token is immediately scrubbed; unused invitations can be revoked.

nodes.label: Invitation tombstone retention
nodes.rationale: Acceptance removes stored token hash and intended email. Accepted, revoked and expired tombstones are retained at most30days and pruned at API startup; live unused invitations remain until expiry.

nodes.label: Hosted identity deployment gates
nodes.rationale: Local beta uses invitations and cookie sessions; passkeys, account recovery, TLS termination and production hosted identity remain gates.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Digest-pinned Docker self-hosting
nodes.rationale: Docker Compose starts static workbench/API with public signup/demo login disabled. Generated admin key is /data/launch-secret; nimanto-data volume retains database/artifacts. CI builds image, but v0.9.0 is not certified for internet exposure.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Private runtime data root
nodes.rationale: Default .nimanto-data contains database, tenant/packet artifacts, explicit local test outbox and mode0600 launch secret; NIMANTO_DATA_DIR overrides it. Cloud sync entails provider retention/access. POSIX directories0700/files0600; Windows requires private user profile and future reviewed ACL installer.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Stopped full-directory backup
nodes.rationale: Copy or replace the entire .nimanto-data directory while API is stopped; beta claims neither online backups, point-in-time recovery nor schema downgrade support.

nodes.label: Tenant deletion write fence
nodes.rationale: Deletion first fences tenant writes and captures exact outbox inventory, then removes tenant rows, packet/outbox files and session. Writes/provider effects must complete before the fence or fail, preventing untracked files afterward.

nodes.label: Seven-day deletion status token
nodes.rationale: Post-deletion sign-in receipt exposes a seven-day bearer token, the only candidate-facing public status/resume capability. Token is page-only, lost on reload/close, works without a session and must be kept private/out of shell history.

nodes.label: Deletion completion versus pending cleanup
nodes.rationale: Workspace deleted means rows and local files gone; cleanup-pending means tenant/session removed but files remain. Public status GET and resume POST use the candidate token.

nodes.label: Autonomous deletion recovery
nodes.rationale: API startup and authenticated worker reconcile unfinished cleanup without candidate bearer token, without exposing public status/resume. Completed tombstones prune after seven days; unfinished work is never age-pruned. New local session creates a fresh labeled synthetic workspace.

nodes.label: Public-board discovery schedule
nodes.rationale: Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board identifiers run hourly, six-hour, daily or weekly; candidates can run now, pause, resume or cancel. Cycle claims at most3due schedules and500roles/source, deduplicates provider job IDs and publishes deterministic explanations; fifth consecutive failure dead-letters, Resume resets budget.

nodes.label: Discovery-only worker boundary
nodes.rationale: Queue contains provider/board IDs only; scheduled work cannot prepare/approve packets, email, submit or open Slice4 actions. pnpm dev/macOS launcher include worker; dev:core/start omit it for deterministic testing; start:all includes it.

nodes.label: Private evidence lens
nodes.rationale: Literal claim text, source names and locators search with type/decision/source filters is tab-local, changes no claim and clears on reload or identity boundary.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Tab-local role discovery filters
nodes.rationale: Search/source/match/tracking/archive filters survive section navigation, clear on reload/sign-out/deletion/identity change and never reach API as preferences.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Two-role comparison
nodes.rationale: At most two tab-local Role IDs show current values, latest explanations, literal coverage/evidence needs/blockers/compensation/benefits without ranking or inferred employer outcome.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Match Evidence Strength basis
nodes.rationale: Evidence lens separates fit from stored supported/source-linked/candidate-attested counts and rule versions. Source-linkage ordinal is unweighted and cannot alter fit; historical missing counts are not invented, and re-explaining creates a current basis.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Reviewed URL intake
nodes.rationale: Exact host allowlist and terms-review date enable explicit candidate URL/normalized-field intake; redirects and unsafe destinations fail closed.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Exact H-1B role wording review
nodes.rationale: Separate current role wording, employer policy and historical government records; acknowledge/clear exact quotes. New Role content or Match Publication invalidates review without changing fit or hiding role.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Historical H-1B provenance and freshness
nodes.rationale: Retain full locator, period, observed time, confidence, freshness, downgraded original label and limitations; historical context is neither legal advice nor current employer promise.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Candidate recorded timeline
nodes.rationale: Timeline consists of retained status events, completed activities, candidate outcomes and literal private notes; migration markers are observed snapshots, and missing dates/silence imply no earlier stage.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Candidate Career Ledger
nodes.rationale: Typed activities, interview rounds, manual contacts/referrals, versioned answers, saved views, sample-sized durations and candidate offer terms remain Application-adjacent; no scraping, messaging, autofill, notification, prediction or provider sync.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Shared application outcome editor
nodes.rationale: Board/table work surfaces precede aggregate counts and share deliberate outcome editing; outcome recording does not change Application status.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Candidate follow-up date
nodes.rationale: One strict date-only value drives Review due; future dates suppress336-hour fallback. No contact/status change/background job/inferred response. Withdrawn Applications retain date visibly but inactive; clear allowed, date setting/changing blocked until Tracked.

nodes.label: Local calendar reminder export
nodes.rationale: ICS export includes active candidate-set dates as local all-day events without creating Nimanto notifications/jobs.

nodes.label: Private application decision lens
nodes.rationale: Tab-local role/company/private-note/outcome search and status/current-source/follow-up filters sort by explicit stored field without altering funnel/cohort counts.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Spreadsheet-safe shown-record export
nodes.rationale: CSV exports current filtered view, tracker fields and note/outcome counts; excludes private bodies. JSON export contains complete candidate-owned record.

nodes.label: Exact draft snapshot preservation
nodes.rationale: Signed-in tab retains unfinished fields and application view controls across sections. Successful save clears only its exact submitted snapshot, preserving newer typing. Discard clears relevant draft; reload/identity boundaries clear all. View/filter/cohort state is not candidate fact.

nodes.label: Record-review queue
nodes.rationale: Prefer candidate-set date; otherwise Review due after336elapsed hours from latest literal creation/status/completed activity/outcome. Label basis, exclude withdrawn records, and infer/contact nothing.

nodes.label: Application cohort counts
nodes.rationale: Explicit local-time creation window and optional current source/band filters produce raw counts only; unmatched has no stored match, unknown retains unrecognized stored band. No rates/predictions.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Read-only Application dossier
nodes.rationale: One Application case file joins current Role/Match, Packet/Assurance history, ledger/evidence lens, external actions and Submission Records without inferred employer timeline or acknowledgment.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Candidate-authored Submission Record
nodes.rationale: Record actual external channel/destination/time plus exact current approved composed Packet/formats or explicit materials-not-captured. Nimanto neither submits nor calls this record a receipt.

nodes.label: Frozen Packet composition
nodes.rationale: Select ordered1-8confirmed claims from exact Application Profile Version with current Match links. Profile/Role/Match/evidence changes fail closed; all formats share frozen composition, identical inputs reproduce canonical hash.

nodes.label: Exact reviewed Assurance approval
nodes.rationale: Inspect canonical content, document_assurance_v1, hashes and latest run. Checks concern structure/configured rules, not truth, quality, acceptance or delivery. Approval refuses changed Packet/manifest hashes or superseding Assurance Run.

nodes.label: Copy-only loopback Ollama draft
nodes.rationale: Candidate selects exact confirmed claims sent to responding local model; unverified copy-only output cannot enter Packet without separate candidate action outside the panel.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Packet and Assurance history
nodes.rationale: On-demand per-Application packet generations compare literal canonical/manifest differences, not lineage. Status/manifests are mutable current fields; Assurance ordinals are packet-local, not global store sequence.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: On-demand Profile and Match history
nodes.rationale: Cursor pagination loads when opened; Profile diffs compare exact claim IDs/authorization wording. Neutral A/B handles reverse/same selections. Same-role Match comparison reveals rules, blockers and hashes without causality, replay guarantee or immutable Role history.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Unsigned internal receipt integrity
nodes.rationale: Dashboard verifies internal receipt hash and exposes input/artifact/receipt hashes; tamper-evident unsigned records are not external acknowledgments.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Sensitive workspace inspection export
nodes.rationale: After sensitive-data confirmation, nimanto-local-beta-v10 wraps nimanto_export_v10 with discovery/role provenance, trust/dataset manifests, employers/aliases, profile/match/assurance/packet/wording, applications/submissions, full Answer revisions/ledger/offers and receipts. Excludes discarded raw provider bodies, sessions, invitation secrets, deletion internals and generated files. Inspection only, not restore/backup/replay.

nodes.label: Local verification and static run
nodes.rationale: pnpm check, build and test:e2e verify local work; production-like static run uses build then start. SHA256 manifest validates v0.9.0 CycloneDX/SPDX inventories, not a signed installer; GitHub generates source archives, no desktop binary is published.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Local service and rate-limit recovery
nodes.rationale: Check loopback health status;429RATE_LIMITED is wait/retry rather than disconnected. Port conflicts require stopping owner or matching API_PORT/API_ORIGIN and rebuilding web.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Blocked Packet recovery
nodes.rationale: Run assurance and inspect required findings such as no confirmed evidence, missing/changed authorization wording or prohibited outcome promise.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Current Profile Version rebind
nodes.rationale: Superseded Application Profile blocks composition/actions/submissions. Explicit rebind moves only that Application, approved_for_export returns Prepared while external submission/withdrawal survive. Republish Match, compose/assure/approve anew; old Packet remains historical and unusable for actions/submissions.

nodes.label: Submission currentness gate
nodes.rationale: Captured materials require latest approved packet_v2 with current Profile/Match/Role/evidence/manifest/hashes. Refresh dossier and recreate/assure/approve current Packet, or choose genuine uncaptured-materials option.

nodes.label: External-action currentness and runtime gate
nodes.rationale: Action needs exact current approved Packet, separate approval and runtime opt-in; creation/approval/execution recheck currentness under packet-generation lock. New Packet retires older approval; runtime switch resets on API restart.

nodes.label: Replaced-session mutation recovery
nodes.rationale: A replaced/revoked loaded session causes mutation rejection before route handler and clearing old workspace before refresh. Reopen intended workspace and review current stored state before retry; do not assume rejected write committed.

nodes.label: Ambiguous-action reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Never retry ambiguous action because provider effect may precede uncertain outcome persistence; inspect action ID/outbox/mail state and linked provider boundaries. v0.9.0 retains do-not-retry audit trail.
nodes.community_name: Run and operate the local beta

nodes.label: Connected-account sending unavailable
nodes.rationale: Gmail/Outlook connected sending is outside v0.9.0; use local test outbox or candidate-opened deep link and provider boundaries.
